adherent enteropathogenic E. coli strains contain a larger lipopolosaccharide core structure than non-adherent ones.

the core of the adherent strains of EPEC 0119 is larger than the non-adherent strains.
the core of adherent E. coli 0119 strain JCP88 is larger than the non-adherent E. coli 19392 strain.
the core of the non-adherent 19392 strain is typical of enteropathogenic E. coli, whereas that of the adherent strain JPC88 is atypical and is similar to that of the rough mutant of JPC88.

the core structure of adherent strains of enteropathogens is more complex than the core of non-adherent strains.

the core oligosaccharides of enteropathogenic E. coli strains 0119 are not identical.
